name: probe_rsvd_95e
note: only cleared (task_timing_probe reset pass); end bound of bss_clear_tasks

name: probe_ms10
note: task_timing_probe: probe_ms / 10, stored as chan_meas[probe_idx].signal high byte

name: magvar_llh
note: h, lat, lon doubles at the last mag_var computation (magvar_update); pos_get_llh distance > 2000 m triggers a recompute

name: nsv_pr
note: channels with chan_use.use_pr (nav_step; between nsv_pos and nsv_time)

name: pps_adj_hold
note: pps_schedule: set after a nonzero ms_adjust; next pass forces ms_adjust 0 and clears it

name: dgps_age_n
note: pos_smooth: averaging count 1-50 for dgps_age_avg; 1 on reseed or stale corrections

name: vel_jump_count
note: vel_smooth (param 5): consecutive 3D velocity jumps held; > 2 accepts vel_sol; cleared by pos_smooth reseed

name: epochs_since_2d
note: u16 pos_smooth: 0 while the previous mode was 2 (2D), else +1 (max $FFFE); entering 2D: height gain = table $0AE9BA[$8EB8] / this, height reset if this > table

name: dgps_age_avg
note: double, running mean of correction age gps_seconds - dgps_time/10 over dgps_age_n (pos_smooth; init 5.0); gain = this/100 (all locked) or /500

name: dgps_age_prev
note: double, correction age of the previous pass (pos_smooth; init 1.0); prev^2 - age^2 > 100/1000 forces a reseed

name: vsm_hdop
note: double, vel_smooth: HDOP of the previous 2D/3D pass (0 otherwise); jump test |dHDOP| x 0.56

name: vsm_hdop_save
note: double, vsm_hdop committed with pos_filt_prev (mode 2/3); restored on a mode-5 reject

name: vsm_vdop
note: double, vel_smooth: VDOP of the previous 2D pass (0 otherwise)

name: vsm_vdop_save
note: double, vsm_vdop committed with pos_filt_prev; restored on reject

name: alt_hold_prev
note: pos_smooth: alt_hold_on of the previous pass; 1 keeps height = sol_llh

name: dgps_age_reseed
note: pos_smooth: 1 forces a reseed on the next corrected pass (set at start and while diff_stale)

name: nav_mode_prev
note: pos_smooth: nav_mode of the previous pass

name: pos_hold_prev
note: pos_smooth: pos_hold_on of the previous pass; 1 forces a reseed

name: cold_fix_count
note: nav_cold_fix passes since nav_init_pos; > 3 sets cold_fix_first

name: pred_in_datum_dy
note: double, pred_in datum dy (task_vis_predict compares with datum_dy)

name: init_pos_mode
note: only cleared (nav_reset); nav_init_pos: 1, or 0 without sv_select_have_pred -> start from the SV-position centroid

name: osc_search_count
note: entries in osc_search_list (osc_search_step builds the oscillator setting list, current setting last)

name: osc_search_ptr
note: pointer into osc_search_list (osc_search_step); wraps at osc_search_list + osc_search_count

name: vis_wait_busy
note: srch_hold_flags: vis_busy when navigation was last seen; after fix loss wait for vis_buf != vis_wait_buf

name: vis_wait_none
note: srch_hold_flags: vis_state = 3 (no prediction) when navigation was last seen

name: vis_wait_buf
note: srch_hold_flags: vis_buf expected after the running prediction

name: vis_wait_state
note: srch_hold_flags: vis_state expected after the next prediction; reached -> srch_ctl +$3A = 1

name: chan_tx_bit_ms
note: [8] chan_report.bit_ms at the last chan_tx_time pass (ms-in-bit phase for the ms count $E8A)

name: chan_state_prev
note: [8] chan_report.state at the last chan_range_smooth pass; carrier smoothing only if > 3

name: chan_bit_phase
note: [8] ms-in-bit phase (0-19) at the last chan_bit_count pass; > 19 reset to 10

name: mv_dec
note: double, declination deg = atan2(by, bx) / dtr (magvar_model return; geomag.c)

name: mv_dt
note: float, years since epoch $0AF57E, clamped 0-5 (geomag.c dt)

name: mv_temp1
note: float, tc x cp + tc x sp (also holds (q1 + a2)/(q1 + b2) before q2)

name: mv_temp2
note: float, tc x sp - tc x cp

name: mv_r
note: float, geocentric radius (was typed double; two floats r, d)

name: cl_date
note: date_rec, @@Cl echo date and time (pos_time_snapshot from date_time; cl_parse_date, cl_parse_time)

name: cl_mask
note: word, @@Cl echo elevation mask (pos_time_snapshot from el_mask; cl_parse_mask)

name: cl_offset
note: @@Cl echo local offset: hour byte, minute byte, signed (pos_time_snapshot; cl_parse_offset)

name: cl_rsvd_3680
note: double, @@Cl output field (x2) before cl_rsvd_3678; always 0

name: cd_offset_min
note: local offset minutes byte after cd_offset (cd_parse_offset)

name: eph_hold_on
note: @@AA 0/1 (cmd_AA, reply_AA); cleared by rcvr_init, not saved. 1 = eph_word_store clears the collect mask while the channel ephemeris is valid

name: opt_G_copy
note: EEPROM $08FF == 'G' (id_options_decode, same test as opt_G); no reader

name: sv_manual_chan_sv
note: [8] = sv_manual_list + 1, @@Ai SV per channel 0-7 (sv_search_select, osc_search_reset); cmd_Tb/reply_Tb index sv_manual_dopp from $9CFA with channel 1-8

name: out_cnt_Ba
note: countdown of slot 0 (array base: countdown of slot n at +2n; out_rate_sync, set_output_rate, out_rates_load)

name: nmea_cnt_gga
note: $GPGGA countdown (array base: countdown n at +4n; eeprom_save_rate, out_rates_load)

name: rtcm_resume_word
note: word index where rtcm_frame ran out of input (array base: previous word at +4n for D29/D30)

name: rtcm_resume_body
note: 1 = rtcm_frame paused inside the data words; resume at rtcm_resume_word

name: rtcm_corr_rrc_iod
note: rtcm_corr + 4, stride 6: RRC byte, IOD byte (rtcm_type1_unpack)
